Marmoush starts! Tottenham predicted lineup to play Manchester United as Roberto De Zerbi eyes first Premier League win of the season

    Here is how Tottenham could line up against Manchester United at Old Trafford.

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 3:43
    Instaread

    Desperate to get their first win of the Premier League season, Tottenham Hotspur travel to Old Trafford to face Manchester United on Saturday evening.

    Powered By
    10 Sec

    Next
    Stay

    After back-to-back goalless draws with Nottingham Forest and Everton, Roberto De Zerbi’s side were beaten 3-2 by Aston Villa at home. The defeat to Aston Villa, combined with other results, saw the Lilywhites enter the September international break rock bottom in the table.

    Roberto De Zerbi has had three weeks to reconsider his tactics and find solutions to his team’s problems. The 47-year-old is already feeling the heat of the fans and the media, especially after he oversaw a massive summer expenditure. The Italian will be hoping his boys turn up this time around and register their first win when they face Manchester United, who have only five points on board from as many games and find themselves 12th in the table.

    That said, here is the predicted Tottenham lineup for the upcoming league fixture vs. Man United.

    Goalkeeper: Antonin Kinsky

    Antonin Kinsky earned his first senior cap for Czechia during the international break, starting in goal in the 3-1 defeat to Spain in the UEFA Nations League. The 23-year-old will be keen to keep his third clean sheet of the league season when Spurs lock horns with Man United.

    Defence: Archie Gray, Tosin Adarabioyo, Micky van de Ven, Destiny Udogie

    Tottenham were dealt a double injury blow during the international break when both Jan Paul van Hecke and Micky van de Ven sustained injuries on Netherlands duty. Roberto De Zerbi has been sweating on the Dutch pair’s fitness, but recent reports suggest their injuries are not serious and they could be fit to face Man United.

    That said, however, we think Van Hecke will not be risked on Saturday, with De Zerbi opting for Tosin Adarabioyo to pair Van de Ven in central defence. Pedro Porro is sidelined with a hamstring injury, which should open the door for Archie Gray to start at right-back. Andy Robertson has started the season as the first-choice left-back, but as he was heavily involved for Scotland during the international break, De Zerbi could decide to go with Destiny Udogie from the off against Man United.

    Midfield: Sandro Tonali, Rodrigo Bentancur, Mateus Fernandes

    Sandro Tonali, Rodrigo Bentancur and Mateus Fernandes were all heavily involved for their respective nations during the international break. Tonali had a mixed time with Italy but ended the break on a high note against Turkiye. Bentancur was a part of the Uruguay squad that smashed India 6-1 in a friendly fixture on Tuesday, while Fernandes helped Portugal conclude 2027 UEFA European U21 Championship qualifiers with a 2-0 win against Czechia.

    Tonali and Bentancur are likely to resume their midfield partnership, hoping to take control of the game at the earliest and create opportunities for the attackers in the final third. Fernandes will act as a link between midfield and attack, with Lucas Bergvall having to be content with a spot on the bench again.

    Attack: Savio, Dominic Solanke, Omar Marmoush

    Savio and Dominic Solanke were not picked by their respective nations, so the duo stayed back in North London and continued building up their fitness. Omar Marmoush was among the goals for Egypt during the international break, which could act as a confidence-booster ahead of Tottenham’s trip to United.

    Marmoush and Savio are expected to start wide, providing pace, creativity and directness to the visitors’ attack. Despite struggling with physical levels, Solanke is expected to spearhead the Tottenham attack. Mohammed Kudus, Mathys Tel and James Maddison could provide attacking impetus off the bench when required.
